---
title: "Prétraitement de données"
author: "ATTUOMAN PRINCE JOSIAS KOFFI"
date: "2026-09-30"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(data.table)

brut <- fread("assurance_sale.csv", sep = ";", colClasses = "character", encoding = "UTF-8")
if ("ClaimAmount" %in% names(brut)) brut[, ClaimAmount := NULL]

setnames(brut,
  c("IDpol", "ClaimNb", "Exposure", "Area", "VehPower", "VehAge",
    "DrivAge", "BonusMalus", "VehBrand", "VehGas", "Density", "Region"),
  c("numero_police", "nb_sinistres", "exposition_annees", "zone_densite",
    "puissance_vehicule", "age_vehicule", "age_conducteur", "bonus_malus",
    "marque_vehicule", "carburant", "densite_habitants_km2", "region"))
n_brut <- nrow(brut)

manquants <- c("", "NA", "N/A", "?", "INCONNU")
nettoyer  <- function(x) { x <- toupper(trimws(x)); x[x %in% manquants] <- NA_character_; x }
en_nombre <- function(x) as.numeric(sub(",", ".", nettoyer(x), fixed = TRUE))

polices <- copy(brut)
polices[, numero_police := sub("^POL0", "", toupper(trimws(numero_police)))]
polices[, `:=`(
  zone_densite    = nettoyer(zone_densite),
  marque_vehicule = gsub("[ -]", "", nettoyer(marque_vehicule)),
  region = {
    r <- gsub("[ -]", "", nettoyer(region))
    fifelse(is.na(r) | startsWith(r, "R"), r, paste0("R", r))
  },
  carburant = {
    g <- nettoyer(carburant)
    fcase(g %in% c("REGULAR", "ESSENCE", "SP95", "E"), "Essence",
          g %in% c("DIESEL", "GAZOLE", "D"), "Diesel",
          !is.na(g), "AUTRE",
          default = NA_character_)
  }
)]

entiers <- c("nb_sinistres", "puissance_vehicule", "age_vehicule",
             "age_conducteur", "bonus_malus", "densite_habitants_km2")
polices[, (entiers) := lapply(.SD, function(x) as.integer(round(en_nombre(x)))), .SDcols = entiers]
polices[, exposition_annees := en_nombre(exposition_annees)]

# doublons exacts puis une ligne par police
polices <- unique(polices)
n_sans_doublons <- nrow(polices)
setorder(polices, numero_police)

somme_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
polices <- polices[, .(
  nb_sinistres = as.integer(somme_na(nb_sinistres)),
  exposition_annees = somme_na(exposition_annees),
  zone_densite = zone_densite[1],
  puissance_vehicule = puissance_vehicule[1],
  age_vehicule = age_vehicule[1],
  age_conducteur = age_conducteur[1],
  bonus_malus = bonus_malus[1],
  marque_vehicule = marque_vehicule[1],
  carburant = carburant[1],
  densite_habitants_km2 = densite_habitants_km2[1],
  region = region[1],
  nb_lignes_sources = .N
), by = numero_police]
n_polices <- nrow(polices)

# valeurs impossibles
polices[age_vehicule < 0 | age_vehicule >= 100, age_vehicule := NA]
polices[age_conducteur < 18 | age_conducteur > 100, age_conducteur := NA]
polices[puissance_vehicule <= 0 | puissance_vehicule > 20, puissance_vehicule := NA]
polices[bonus_malus < 50 | bonus_malus > 230, bonus_malus := NA]
polices[densite_habitants_km2 <= 0 | densite_habitants_km2 > 30000, densite_habitants_km2 := NA]
polices[exposition_annees <= 0, exposition_annees := NA]

# exposition > 1 an : impossible et non corrigeable, la ligne est exclue
nb_exposition_sup_1 <- polices[exposition_annees > 1, .N]
polices <- polices[is.na(exposition_annees) | exposition_annees <= 1]

# manquants
n_expo_na <- polices[is.na(exposition_annees), .N]
polices <- polices[!is.na(exposition_annees)]

colonnes_num <- c("puissance_vehicule", "age_vehicule", "age_conducteur",
                  "bonus_malus", "densite_habitants_km2")
colonnes_cat <- c("zone_densite", "marque_vehicule", "carburant", "region")
polices[, ligne_imputee := rowSums(is.na(.SD)) > 0, .SDcols = c(colonnes_num, colonnes_cat)]

for (v in colonnes_num) {
  med <- median(polices[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  set(polices, which(is.na(polices[[v]])), v, as.integer(round(med)))
}

for (v in colonnes_cat) {
  set(polices, which(is.na(polices[[v]])), v, "Inconnu")
}

# polices à plus de 5 sinistres
n_plus_5 <- polices[nb_sinistres > 5, .N]
polices <- polices[nb_sinistres <= 5]

# tranches (définies ici une seule fois, pour Power BI et pour le modèle)
polices[, `:=`(
  tranche_age_conducteur = cut(age_conducteur, c(17, 21, 25, 30, 40, 50, 70, 100),
    labels = c("1. 18-21", "2. 22-25", "3. 26-30", "4. 31-40", "5. 41-50", "6. 51-70", "7. 71 et +")),
  tranche_age_vehicule = cut(age_vehicule, c(-1, 0, 3, 10, 15, 100),
    labels = c("1. 0 an", "2. 1-3 ans", "3. 4-10 ans", "4. 11-15 ans", "5. 16 ans et +")),
  tranche_bonus_malus = cut(bonus_malus, c(49, 50, 60, 80, 100, 230),
    labels = c("1. 50", "2. 51-60", "3. 61-80", "4. 81-100", "5. 101 et +")),
  tranche_densite = cut(densite_habitants_km2, c(0, 50, 200, 1000, 4000, 10000, 30000),
    labels = c("1. 1-50", "2. 51-200", "3. 201-1000", "4. 1001-4000", "5. 4001-10000", "6. plus de 10000")),
  tranche_puissance = cut(puissance_vehicule, c(0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 20),
    labels = c("1. 4 et moins", "2. 5", "3. 6", "4. 7", "5. 8", "6. 9-10", "7. 11 et +")),
  tranche_exposition = cut(exposition_annees, c(0, 0.05, 0.3, 0.99, 1),
    labels = c("1. jusqu'à 0,05 an", "2. 0,05 à 0,3", "3. 0,3 à 0,99", "4. 1 an"))
)]

# contrôles
c(brut = n_brut, sans_doublons = n_sans_doublons, polices = n_polices,
  exposition_sup_1 = nb_exposition_sup_1, expo_na = n_expo_na,
  plus_5 = n_plus_5, final = nrow(polices))

polices[, .(n = .N, sinistres = sum(nb_sinistres),
            freq = sum(nb_sinistres) / sum(exposition_annees)), by = zone_densite][order(zone_densite)]

polices[, .(n = .N, sinistres = sum(nb_sinistres),
            freq = sum(nb_sinistres) / sum(exposition_annees)), by = tranche_exposition][order(tranche_exposition)]

fwrite(polices, "assurance_propre.csv", sep = ";", dec = ",")
saveRDS(polices, "assurance_propre.rds")
```
